'''Hyssop''' is a modern [[Nomai]]. 

Their clan's ancestors are said to have searched for [[The Vessel|Escall's Vessel]] after its disappearance.<ref>HYSSOP: It was a very long time ago, but yes. My clan's ancestors searched for Escall's clan for a long time, but in the end, none of them were ever seen again. (It's the only time in our history a Vessel has ever disappeared this way.)</ref> Hyssop confirmed to the other living Nomai that [[Escall]]'s story is true.<ref>HYSSOP: That's no myth, friends; Escall's clan existed, and their story was real.</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Hyssop may have been named after the ''[[Wikipedia:Hyssopus (plant)|Hyssopus]]'' genus of plants, which are aromatic and have small blue flowers.
